Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: tavern
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A room where guests buy a drink and drink it on the spot. Stock the room with beer or other drinks on a shelf or in a stockpile; a bartender behind the sign or counter keeps it open. Drinks in the room are reserved for customers unless the sign says otherwise.

Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: shop
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A room where guests buy goods. Everything stored on shelves and in stockpiles inside the room is for sale, at market value times the sign's price factor. Without a shopkeeper the shop runs as self-service at a small discount.

Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: restaurant
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A room where guests sit down and eat. Tables, a kitchen and a waiter make it a restaurant; guests pay for the plates and meals on its shelves and tables. Cooking is done by the kitchen; stale plates are not for sale.

Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: casino
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A room of card tables, slot machines and croupiers. Guests stake their silver on games of chance; the house keeps a small, honest edge.

Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: spa
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A quiet room for baths, steam and rest. An attendant keeps the towels warm; guests pay by the visit.

Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: lounge
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A waiting room with seats. Guests who find a business closed or unstaffed wait here instead of in the doorway, and wait more patiently. Always open, no staff needed.

Hearth.VenueTypeDef.label: guest chapel
Hearth.VenueTypeDef.description: A quiet room with a guest altar where visitors of every faith come to pray. Guests pay nothing but leave calmer; a chapel with a handsome altar and a few pews is a good neighbour for an inn. Always open during the day, no staff needed.
